acceptanceCriteria: A fixture Rails app with the stock config/application.rb (Bundler.require(*Rails.groups)) reports scope BOUNDED for an app/models change, covered by a test
A non-standard dynamic require still yields ruby:dynamic-load
RUBY-AFFECTED-V0 is amended; focused affected/ruby tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1795 (PR #1146, RUBY-AFFECTED-V0-009..012). Standard Rails config/application.rb calls `Bundler.require(*Rails.groups)`. The Ruby adapter treats it as ruby:dynamic-load, so a stock Rails app reports scope UNKNOWN even after the autoload-edge narrowing. Expected: the stock Bundler.require form is recognised as gem loading (not app-code loading) and the plan stays BOUNDED; other dynamic requires still raise the frontier. Observed in PR #1146 head af7bb548c, 2026-10-18.
title: Ruby affected: Bundler.require(*Rails.groups) in config/application.rb makes every Rails app UNKNOWN (ruby:dynamic-load)
